name: Website
blurb: The business's public website, ready on its own machine: a Hono site with a brand folder, a design system file, and one command that publishes it to the edge. Build it from the brand, or from a site the owner points at.
directive: The Website Starter App is installed. The app in ~/app is now a Hono website: brand/ (brand.json, tokens.css, voice.md), DESIGN.md (the design rules), src/pages (the pages), and it is serving from this machine as the `web` service (npm run dev on port 3000; check with `sprite-env services get web`). Its skills are in ~/app/.claude/skills: website (build and run the site: pages, brand, images, forms), design and writing (the brief, three directions, the voice card, the copy bar), clone-site (capture a site the owner points at and rebuild it), ship (publish to the edge with `npm run deploy`). Start by reading .claude/skills/website/SKILL.md and ~/app/DESIGN.md, confirm the site answers on the machine, then ask the owner what the site is for: the business, who it is for, what a visitor should do, and whether they have an existing site, brand material, or a site they like. If this project has a Company Brain (tools.taskandtool.project_apps), suggest mirroring its brand and public folders into this app from Settings before designing. Do not invent facts, customers, or prices; reserve honest slots for what does not exist yet. Publishing to the web is the owner's dashboard action.

suggestions.label: Build my website
suggestions.prompt: Build my website. First ask me what you need to know about the business, who the site is for, and what a visitor should do; then fill in brand/brand.json and brand/voice.md, propose three design directions per the design skill, and build the home page from real content.
